title: Monthly Storage Billing for Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN)
content:
**Billing rule.** Storage is billed per SKU per storage month on the storage fee billing day of the following month: the SKU's average daily cubic feet times the rate for its storage class (through the size class map) and season. Months listed as peak-season months use the peak rate, every other month the off-peak rate. The program in force on the last day of the storage month sets the rate. A SKU with no units on hand during the whole storage month is not billed.

## How the storage fee is put together

1. The storage month is a calendar month; each SKU of the Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment is billed separately for it.
2. The volume is the SKU's average daily cubic feet in that month.
3. The storage class follows from the SKU's size tier through the size class map.
4. The season is peak when the month is one of the peak-season months, off-peak otherwise.
5. The rate is the program's rate for that class and season, taken from the program in force on the last day of the storage month.
6. The fee is the volume multiplied by that rate, rounded to the cent, and is billed on the billing day of the next month.

## Cases (hypothetical volumes and rates)

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| SKU held all of August at an average of 50 cubic feet, off-peak standard rate of 1.00 USD | 50.00 USD billed in September |
| SKU with no units on hand on any day of the month | not billed for that month |
| Program changed on 10 October; storage month October | rate of the program in force on 31 October |
| Program changed on 1 November; storage month October | rate of the program in force on 31 October, the earlier program |
